items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What would've, say Buddy Petite's brass band, what numbers would they feature? [INTERVIEWEE] Same numbers like they're playing now.

ctx.x: Oh, I played with, I played with a lot of bands. One of the team and brass bands, Kid Rene, Chris Kelly, Kid Punch. Yeah, play with the, play with the record. I don't play with the exhausts, no, I don't play with them. I was playing, I didn't play good like that. Tuxedo.
What would've, say Buddy Petite's brass band, what numbers would they feature?

Same numbers like they're playing now. Figure the feet. All of the numbers. Same numbers like they're playing now. What would that be? High society all of them numbers like that. They all of the same numbers they're playing now.
